tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rta mgrin dmar po'i mngon rtogs rgyas pa bzhugs so//

༄༅// "$ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// snying rje'i bdag nyid can yin kyang*// ma traṃ ru dra'i ma rungs par/ khros te tshar gcod phyir bstan pa// pad+ma gar dbang de la 'dud// 'dir grub pa'i rgyal mo'i gzhung gi rjes su 'brangs pa rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs rgyas pa zhig bri bar bya'o// de yang bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub ma thob bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis bsnyen sgrubs bgyis pa 'di dag gis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas thob par shog /rang gi snying gar hrīḥdamar po de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyis bla ma rigs bdag gi rnam par bzhugs pa'i rta mgrin la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ dkon mchog gsum dngos bla ma dang*/ khro rgyal rta mgrin gtsor bzhugs pa'i// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus par// rnam pa kun tu phyag 'tshal lo// bdag lus rgyal ba mnyes byed pa// kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin// rab 'byams nam mkha'i khams khyab pa'i// dngos po kun gyis mchod par bgyi// sdig pa ma lus bshags lags shing*// bsod nams kun la yid dga' bas// chos kyi rnga chen brdung bskul te// nam mkha' ji srid bzhugs par gsol// yon gnas dam pa khyed mthus bdag khams gsum ma lus dbang bsdus te// sangs rgyas kun gyi drung phyin nas// dam chos ma lus 'dzin par shog /lan gsum gyis tshogs zhing rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sogs tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom/ sems can thams cad kyi don du dpal chen po rta mgrin gyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rnal 'byor gyi rim pa la 'jug par bya'o snyam pas snying ga'i hrīḥ ye shes kyi mer 'bar rnam smin gyi lus bsregs nas stong pa nyid du gyur/

oṃ swa bhā wa shud dhāḥsarbadharmaḥ swa bhā wa shud dho:haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las sngon gyi smon lam gyi 'phen pas rgyu byas snying rjes rkyen byas te/ skad cig gis rin po che dmar po'i khams las grub pa'i dkyil 'khor zla gam/ mdun bcad kha'i phyogs su sgo yod pa/ nang yangs shing rgya che ba'i lte bar pad+ma dang nyi ma la/ hrīḥdamar po las rdo rje dbyug tho dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid skad cig gis khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rtsa ba'i zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'gyur ba spyan gsum pa dbu skra dang smin ma dang sma ra ser po/ steng du rta zhal ljang zhur rta skad nam mkha'i dbyings su 'tsher bas khams gsum dbang du sdud pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje'i dbyug tho phyar bas bgegs dang 'byung po ma lus pa 'joms shing*/ g.yon thugs kar sdig mdzub mdzad pa'i rtser me 'bar bas gnod byed ma lus pa bsreg pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i cod pan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa brgya'i phyed kyi do shal dang*/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang*/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ khrag gi thig le/ zhag gi zor ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bu/ glang po che'i ko ba dang mi'i pags pas stod g.yogs pa/ stag lpags rlon pas smad dkris pa/ cis kyang mi tshugs pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin/ gshin rje'i gzugs lta bu'i sku las bskal pa'i me'i phung po steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad du dmar 'ur 'ur 'phro ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas bdud bzhi brdzis te pad+ma dang nyi ma la bzhugs pa/ srid pa gsum zil gyis gnon pa nam mkha'i khams khyab pa zhig tu gyur ba'i dpral bar sku rdo rje'i rang bzhin oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje'i rang bzhin āḥdamar po/ snying gar thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin hūm̐ sngon po/ snying nang du dbyug tho dkar po/ hrīḥ dmar pos mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros bsgoms pa ji lta ba'i khro bo'i rgyal pos sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen pos bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par mos te/

hrīḥ las skyes pa'i rta mchog sku// nyi ma'i 'od mtshungs nyon mongs bsreg /bdud bzhi rnam par 'joms mdzad pa'i// dpa' bo rta mgrin gshegs su gsol/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha tshogs rnams spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ gshegs ma rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa phul/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo'i rgyal po rnams kyis bgegs skrod par mdzad pas dbang bskur/ lus gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba la rang rigs kyi bdag po sprul pa sku'i cha byad can gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ dri zhim gtsang dang yid 'phrog pa'i// mchod yon che dang zhal bsil dang*// zhabs bkru thor 'thung so rtsi'i rdzas// mchod pa kun gyi dbyibs su 'bul// oṃ ma hā ar+ghaṃ añca mā nāṃ/ pād+yaṃ/ prok+ṣaṇaṃ/ taṃ bu le pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/ lha rdzas me tog spos kyi mchog /snang gsal byug pa zhal zas dang*// snyan pa'i rol mo rnams kyi sprin// nam mkha'i mdzod las phyung ste 'bul// oṃ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ sha p+ta pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/ dga' ba bsam yas bskyed pa yi// dkyil 'khor kun gyi rtsed 'jo mkhan// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya ma// 'dod pa'i dpyid kyis mchod par bgyi// oṃ rū pa/ shap+ta/ gan+dhe/ rā sa/ spar+she pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/ sgron ma lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga// myos byed rnam pa mang po'i rigs// ming med mthe bong rtse sbyar nas// dngos grub 'dod pas 'bul bar bya// oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/ rnam bcas rnam pa med pa zhes// gnyis med gnyis su byar med pa// shes rab pha rol phyin yum la// mnyam par sbyor ba'i mchod pa bgyi// zhes mchod pa bzhi phul nas// dril bu dang bcas te/

hrīḥ rang bzhin mi 'gyur gdangs la kun tu gzugs// snying rje sbyar bas dbang gi dkyil 'khor cher// hrīḥdamar rdo rje dbyug thor langs nas kyang*// lhang bral mtshal gyi khu ba'i mdog 'dzin sku// sbom thung gsus pa 'phyang zhing lhu rags gel// zhal gdangs mche gtsigs ljags dril spyan gsum dmar// smin ma ag tshoms skra ser 'khyil zhing brjid// 'tshogs mar rta zhal ljang zhur skad 'tsher ba// mu tig phung po dang mtshungs thod pa'i rtse// gser gyi pa tra mdzes lnga'i cod pan dang*/ khrag 'dzag mi mgo dregs pa'i snying spel nas// an+d+rar rgyus pa'i ga sha ring po 'phyang*// stobs ldan klu brgyad kyis brgyan phyag rgyas mdzes// stod gos glang ko sked dkris na ra'i zhing*// sham thabs byā gh+ra'i pags rlon lhab lhub ste// phyag g.yas rdo rje'i dbyug tho rdeg gzas shing*// g.yon pa thugs kar sdigs mdzub rtse la me// bdud kyi snying gar g.yon rol gyi 'gying bag /sgeg pa 'jigs rung drag shul zhud la rngam// kun tu 'od 'phro bskal pa'i me dpung lta'i/ khro bo'i rgyal po khyod la bdag bstod kyi// srid gsum zil mnan khams gsum dbang bsdus te// bdud sde 'joms pa'i dpa' bo sangs rgyas su// myur bar 'gyur ba'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdamar po/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gṝ ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭ ces bskor ba dmar po// rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa bzlas/ de dus 'od zer 'phros sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi byin rlabs bsdus bdag gi sgo gsum yon tan bya ba dang gnyis su med par gyur pas gzi brjid nus pa thams cad 'bar bar bsam/ 'bru 'bum thongs nas/ lus sbyor la/ de las 'od zer lcags kyu zhags pa'i rnam pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ lha 'dre mi gsum zas nor gos gsum sogs gang 'dod par lcags kyus btab/

zhags pas bcings nas bdag gi mdun du bkug bdag gi dbang du 'dus par bsam mo// thun mtshams su gtor ma la lag pa g.yas pa'i snyim pa bkab/ oṃ ma dag pa sbyangs/ g.yon pa bkab/ āḥmang por spel/ gnyis ka bkab/ hūm̐ bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron ma lnga'i rang bzhin du sbar/ nam mkha' lding gi phyag rgya bcings/ hoḥye shes kyi bdud rtsir zhu bar bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ zhes lan bdun brjod/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ des bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin la bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro chos skyong sde brgyad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs snying po'i mthar sa pa ri wā ra btags la 'bul/ ci 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /khro rgyal rta mgrin 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yis la 'khod par shog/ ces smon lam btab bo// 'di ni gsal rje bla ma skal bzang dbang pos gsol ba btab pa'i ngor dge slong pad+ma dkar pos byams pa chen po'i chos gling du sbyar ba'o/// /
